cardOverview.overviewText: An EazyDiner Signature variant providing premium dining privileges, higher discounts, milestone rewards, and exclusive access to curated dining experiences.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy guaranteed discounts of 25%(capped at ₹1000) and up to 50% at over 2,000 partner restaurants.|Receive a 25% discount on dining bills using PayEazy on the EazyDiner app.With the EazyDiner IndusInd Bank Credit Card via PayEazy, get an additional 25% off, excluding consecutive transactions at the same restaurant within 120 minutes.|In a month, the discount is capped at INR 2,000 without any spends criteria.|To unlock additional discount of INR 3,000 in the same month.Spend INR 30,000 in previous calendar month on non- dining transactions.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the EazyDiner app or website using your registered account. Browse exclusive dining and order-in offers, select your preferred restaurants or meals, and apply the offer at checkout. Complete the payment using your IndusInd EazyDiner Signature credit card to enjoy curated dining privileges and discounts.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Every diner receives a complimentary premium alcoholic beverage at over 200 select restaurants. Pair your favorite nibbles with exotic tipples. Visit the EazyDiner App to view participating restaurants using the 'Free Drink' filter on the restaurant listing page. The offer applies only when booking through the EazyDiner App at select restaurants. Brand and serving size are at the restaurant's discretion.
